reader_summary.headline: Tom Bushey is the founder of Sunderland Capital, a Boston-based hedge fund he started in 2016.
reader_summary.overview: Tom Bushey is the founder of Sunderland Capital, a Boston-based hedge fund he started in 2016. Tom graduated from the Wharton School as an undergraduate, and worked as an investment banker at Credit Suisse First Boston, private equity analyst at Thayer Capital. Even with that stellar resume, the road to success running an asset management business has plenty of obstacles along the way.

key_points.text: Tom graduated from the Wharton School as an undergraduate, and worked as an investment banker at Credit Suisse First Boston.
Our conversation tells Tom's story of what happened through his career and launch process.
He shares an inside look from a manager's perspective of what it takes to get a fund off the ground.
